title: Persist tasks as a JSON file
context: The brief wants persistence now and floats 'a real database eventually'. File-vs-DB is reversible (two-way door), but the RECORD SHAPE is not: every future migration reads today's persisted schema.
decision: Persist as a single tasks.json: a list of task objects with id, title, due (ISO date or null), done (ISO datetime or null), added (ISO datetime).
consequences: Zero dependencies; trivially inspectable; a future DB import is a single well-defined mapping. Cost: no concurrent writers (ASM-001).
confirmation: TEST-002 asserts a round-trip of the exact record shape; any shape change requires a superseding ADR.
